snip.t: Autonomic testing – bladder scan, perianal sensation; spinal cord compression or cauda equina syndrome.
Confirmatory diagnosis – Correlate a compatible clinical picture (pain, motor/sensory/autonomic deficits, sensory level) with imaging that demonstrates compression of the cord or cauda equina.
Neurological examination: perianal sensation, anal tone, and the bulbocavernosus reflex in suspected cauda equina syndrome (urinary retention with saddle anaesthesia).
